key_insight: A neuro-symbolic AI system can accurately automate complex pathology quality-measure abstraction from narrative reports by combining language-model extraction with symbolic reasoning and human-in-the-loop refinement.
clinical_relevance: This approach could reduce manual reporting burden and make more clinically meaningful quality measures feasible to measure at scale from pathology documentation.
method: Decomposed each quality measure into atomic questions.
Aligned the system to real-world pathology reports using case-based refinement.
Compared NSAI with trained human abstractors on 2,000 independently double-abstracted reports across four CAP pathology measures.
evidence_signal: Against an adjudicated gold standard, NSAI achieved Cohen’s kappa = 0.95, matching or slightly exceeding trained human abstractors (kappa = 0.92), with strongest performance on Gastrointestinal Metaplasia (CAP 43).
watch_item: Performance was evaluated on specific pathology quality measures, so broader generalization and safe deployment will still require validation across sites, report styles, and model backends.
paper_title: Neuro-Symbolic AI for Automated Pathology Quality Measurement
